observations: [2026-06-19] Domain covers the closed-loop workflow-improvement system: chat-export analyzer (scripts/analyze-chat-exports.mjs) + workflow-reviews.json cadence ledger + Phase 0 prelude reminder in compliance.instructions.md + Phase 4 field 8 reminder in persistence.instructions.md Handoff Architect + session-self-review recipe in docs/workflows/.

[2026-06-19] Analyzer reads VS Code Copilot JSONL transcripts at %APPDATA%/Code/User/workspaceStorage/<hash>/GitHub.copilot-chat/transcripts/*.jsonl. Emits 5-category metrics: Tool Discipline, Course-Correction, Cost/Efficiency, Scope Discipline, Outcome Quality. No deps, pure node:fs ESM.

[2026-06-19] Cadence ledger workflow-reviews.json lives under docs/chat-exports/ which is gitignored — file is local-only, syncs across machines via OneDrive but never committed. Fresh machine gets graceful 'no review on file yet' fallback per Phase 0 prelude rule.

[2026-06-19] Baseline 21-session analysis surfaced three patterns: grep-for-symbol abuse (~71% of sessions), low memory-write rate (~29%), terminal-echo recursion driving wasted assistant turns. Magnitudes are PRE-era-tagging — qualitatively defensible only until practice-stream tagging ships.

[2026-06-19] Shipped rule edits in same session: compliance:grep-gate, compliance:terminal-echo-rule, persistence:phase-4-composite-gate, compliance:workflow-cadence-check, persistence:workflow-review-cadence-field. Commits b007d78 / 6f27c58 / d3a5392 / 37b904f / e326dba — all local, none pushed.

[2026-06-19] Cadence thresholds (locked in both Phase 0 prelude and Phase 4 field 8): <7d on cadence, 7-14d DUE (recommend session-self-review before feature work), >14d OVERDUE (strongly recommend workflow-improvement sprint).

[2026-06-19] Parked future work in /memories/repo/parked-ideas.md 'Workflow Self-Improvement Loop' entry: workflow-change-log (3-stream: agent-rule-edits + user-practice-adoptions + infra/tooling-changes), reviewed-session ledger with --exclude-reviewed analyzer flag, cohort/before-after comparison, static HTML dashboard surface (path A MVP), Excalidraw flow viz (polish, last priority). Re-entry triggers documented: ≥2 review cycles of data exist OR explicit workflow-improvement sprint OR metrics-summary.md staleness OR ≥3 shipped rule edits to attribute.

[2026-06-19] Forbidden pattern to remember: do NOT skip Phase 0 prelude cadence check on 'small thing' sessions — that is exactly when drift accumulates unnoticed. Trust-I'll-remember is the failure mode the cadence reminder exists to prevent.

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] ADR-0036 shipped (Accepted). Commit chain: 50c6d12 (ADR) → 7da8e27 (seed reviewed-sessions.json + workflow-change-log.json + .gitignore contents-not-directory pattern) → 4ea628a (analyzer era-tagging + --include-reviewed + --mark-reviewed + metrics-by-era.json sidecar) → dcbc721 (Handoff Architect content req #9 + Phase 4 Composite Gate extension) → d6cefb4 (recipe steps 2/3/6a/8 updated). All local, none pushed per user policy.

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] Three new data artifacts. docs/chat-exports/analysis/reviewed-sessions.json (gitignored per ADR-0036 D5, 21-session baseline seeded). docs/chat-exports/analysis/workflow-change-log.json (TRACKED per ADR-0036 D6 — the ONLY tracked exception in docs/chat-exports/; 3 streams seeded: 13 agentRuleEdits + 6 userPracticeAdoptions + 6 infraToolingChanges = 25 entries). docs/chat-exports/analysis/metrics-by-era.json (gitignored, analyzer-emitted; 21 sessions across 9 cohorts on baseline corpus).

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] Analyzer behavior changes. Default mode skips sessions already in reviewed-sessions.json (logs 'Skipping N already-reviewed sessions'). --include-reviewed bypasses the skip for re-baselining. --mark-reviewed appends current run's session IDs to ledger (idempotent — re-running adds 0 new). Era-tagging uses Option A: bucket by session.startTime, set straddleWindow:true when |session.startTime - change.shippedAt| <= 24h. Cohort = sha1(sorted activeRules + activePractices + activeInfra) truncated to 12 hex chars. ZERO changes to writeSummaryMd or metrics-summary.md (per design Q3).

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] Handoff Architect Phase 4 Composite Gate now requires BOTH Memory Keeper open_nodes AND User Practice Adoptions probe (verbatim question: 'Did this session introduce a new user practice, infrastructure change, or tool worth tracking in workflow-change-log.json?'). Field #9 has 3 render branches: appended-with-ids / probed-no-adoptions / probe-pending. The word 'none' is forbidden. Self-attribution rule: rules shipped THIS session must also be appended to agentRuleEdits with stable kebab-case id; double-entry prevented by id uniqueness.

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] .gitignore key learning: cannot un-ignore a file inside an ignored directory. Workaround is contents-not-directory pattern — ignore docs/chat-exports/* and docs/chat-exports/analysis/* (the * suffix matches contents not dir), then re-include the analysis/ directory and the specific workflow-change-log.json file. Pattern lives in .gitignore lines 73-81.

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] Cohort breakdown of 21-session baseline: 9 cohorts, top 5 by sessionCount = (5 sessions, all straddle), (4 sessions, 3 straddle), (4 sessions early-era no active changes), (2 sessions), (2 sessions). High straddle rate is expected for the baseline run because most retroactive change-log entries are dated 2026-06-19 itself — Phase 3 cohort analysis should weight straddle sessions separately or exclude them.

[2026-06-19 Phase 2] Still parked for Phase 3+: static-HTML cohort dashboard (path A), Excalidraw flows, docs/workflows/improvement-intentions.md, retrospective UI on metrics-by-era.json. Re-entry trigger raised: do NOT build the dashboard until at least 2 review cycles of post-Phase-2 data exist and cohort drift is real.
